label: WaterTAP Two-Pass Permeate-Polishing RO
request: Build and solve a true two-pass brackish-water RO train for 2 kg/m3 NaCl feed at 1e-3 m3/s. Use a 70 m2 loose first-pass membrane at 20 bar, repressurize its permeate, and polish it through a 100 m2 tight second-pass membrane at 10 bar. Keep both brine cuts explicit and report pass recoveries, overall recovery, first-pass and final salinity, polishing factor, pump work, and SEC.
